acceptance_rule: leave-one-year-out error <= 50% of total and at least 9 calendar months with their own coefficient; this region: error 15.2%, 12 months

snpp_to_aqua.definition: k(m) = sum(VIIRS_SNPP) / sum(MODIS_AQUA) per calendar month; Aqua-equivalent = SNPP / k(m)

noaa20_to_snpp.definition: tested: k(m) = sum(VIIRS_NOAA20) / sum(VIIRS_SNPP) per calendar month
noaa20_to_snpp.applied: none - NOAA-20 is used 1:1 as S-NPP; see leave_one_year_out.uncalibrated for the error of doing so

current_month.source: VIIRS_NOAA20 near-real-time, on the Aqua scale
current_month.caveat: near-real-time files have no `type` column, so static heat sources are not removed from the current month

static_source_mask.checked_on: standard rows inside the region (same rows the mask was built from)
